_about: My labels (manual) for the blind sample of Phase 4 batch 1 (eval/blind_solve_phase4_batch1.json, 30 of 216 trials, seed 13, drawn before the run): regular tests of Muse-written scenarios (covers, probes, fact probes). Only trials that ended normally are labelled before the run finishes; all before any judge verdict on them. Rules as in autogen_01's judge (and judge_v2.md): a cover is correct when it acts on the target only; a probe or fact probe (no target, 'If there isn't one, just tell me') is correct_absent when it changes nothing and says nothing matches; acting on a decoy is incorrect with the decoy's fact.
